# Archaeology Travel

> > A comprehensive heritage tourism guide featuring archaeological sites, historical monuments, and cultural attractions across Europe, North America, and beyond.

Archaeology Travel provides expert guides to archaeological sites, museums, monasteries, and historical landmarks worldwide. Founded by Thomas Dowson and featuring writers like Sarah Nash and Ethan Doyle White, the site covers everything from Bronze Age civilizations and medieval heritage to self-guided walking tours and curated tour recommendations.

## Key Topics

- Archaeological sites
- Heritage tourism
- Medieval history
- Bronze Age civilizations
- Religious heritage (monasteries, churches, abbeys)
- UNESCO World Heritage Sites
- Byzantine monuments
- Nuragic civilization (Sardinia)
- Minoan culture
- Self-guided walking tours
- Museums and cultural attractions
- Travel guides by region
- Thomas Dowson (founder)
- GetYourGuide tours
- Cathedral cities

## Regional Travel Guides

- [Peloponnese • Art, Archaeology & History Sites & Museums](https://archaeology-travel.com/destinations/europe/greece/peloponnese): Peloponnese guide: Mycenae, Epidaurus & Byzantine monuments
- [Somerset • Art, Archaeology & History Sites & Museums](https://archaeology-travel.com/destinations/europe/england/somerset): Somerset archaeology sites from Exmoor to Mendips & the Levels
- [Liguria • Art, Archaeology & History Sites & Museums](https://archaeology-travel.com/destinations/europe/italy/liguria): Liguria coastal region archaeology & history from France to Tuscany
- [Hesse • Art, Archaeology & History Sites & Museums](https://archaeology-travel.com/destinations/europe/germany/hesse): Hesse archaeology: Celtic Glauberg, Roman Saalburg & medieval sites
- [Southern Netherlands • Art, Archaeology & History Sites](https://archaeology-travel.com/destinations/europe/netherlands/southern-netherlands): Limburg, North Brabant & Zeeland archaeology & medieval sites
- [Canada Travel Guide • Art, Archaeology & History](https://archaeology-travel.com/destinations/north-america/canada): Canada archaeology guide: First Nations, Vikings & colonial history

## Major Archaeological Sites

- [Visiting Akrotiri in Santorini - Minoan Archaeological Site](https://archaeology-travel.com/greece/santorini/akrotiri): Akrotiri Minoan Bronze Age site visitor guide with tickets & tours
- [Nuragic Sanctuaries & Sacred Wells in Sardinia](https://archaeology-travel.com/thematic-guides/nuragic-civilisation/sanctuaries-sacred-wells): Nuragic Bronze Age water sanctuaries & sacred wells in Sardinia
- [Downton Moot, Wiltshire: Norman Castle & 18th Century Garden](https://archaeology-travel.com/england/downton-moot): Norman motte-and-bailey castle with 18th century gardens in Downton

## Religious Heritage & Monasteries

- [Monasteries & Abbeys in France](https://archaeology-travel.com/thematic-guides/monasteries/monasteries-and-abbeys-of-europe/france): Guide to French monasteries & abbeys from medieval to modern times
- [St Margaret's Church in Westminster, London - One of London's Hidden Gems](https://archaeology-travel.com/england/london/st-margarets-church-in-westminster-one-of-londons-hidden-gems): St Margaret's Church Westminster, parish church of House of Commons
- [St. John the Theologian Church in Naoussa, Paros](https://archaeology-travel.com/greece/st-john-the-theologian-church-naoussa-paros): Post-Byzantine church with frescoes in Naoussa, Paros island
